title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 66 Grove Court in Elgin, Illinois, as the Corporal Alex Martinez Memorial Post Office Building.
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 66 Grove Court in Elgin, Illinois, as the "Corporal Alex Martinez Memorial Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Names a post office building in Elgin, Illinois, after Corporal Alex Martinez.
summary.what_it_does: This law officially renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 66 Grove Court in Elgin, Illinois, as the Corporal Alex Martinez Memorial Post Office Building. It is an honorary designation and does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 12, 2019, and the designation took effect on that date.
